_doc: Item sets (Item Database rule 22, Formulas J; world-depth Stage 5, 2026-11-26). A set: id, name ("English (Hán-Việt)"), pieces (2-5 named template ids, as combat_library.json items), bonuses and story. A bonus with `modifiers` (catalogue keys with scopes) applies while set_bonus_min_pieces distinct pieces are worn (Formulas J1, about half one item's budget); a bonus with `effect` (its name) applies at the full set, run through its engine record `record` (an Effect dict, id set:<id>:full) or listed as unmodelled until it is written. Read by tools/design/combat_sim/fight.py, BuildFileCompiler and StatSheet. Empty until the Stage 6 sect exports fill it (the depth sets sit in design/world/depth/sects/*.items.json until then).

sets.name: Black and White Stones (Hắc Bạch Tử)
sets.story: Made and won by her own hands, never issued by the Pavilion. A go player's pair: the white side shown, the black side kept.

sets.name: Clear Glaze (Lưu Ly Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The sword and ring are the Keeper's gifts at her disciple's Kết Đan; the robe is Khương's own. She wears the set as an heir would, and asks every year why it is not the Regalia.

sets.name: Fisher's Heirs (Ngư Gia Song Kiện)
sets.story: One piece from his master and one from his grandmother, the Pavilion and the fallen sect. Liễu wears both and has told neither giver about the other.

sets.name: Glacier Vigil (Băng Bích Thủ Tịch)

bonuses.effect: The Peak Does Not Move (Phong Bất Động)

sets.story: Two pieces from Tần Ngưng Sương, the banner from the Array's laying and the seal from her deathbed, and one Cố cut from her own cave wall. Cố has worn all three since 1010 and has not come down. Whoever she gives the seal to will learn the last order.

sets.name: Ice-Fisher's Three (Băng Ngư Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Second Wind on the Ice (Băng Thượng Hồi Khí)

sets.story: Made by the coast for its own man: the blade forged at Trấn Sa from a fisher's ice-cutter, the coat from Đoàn's family, the gourd refilled by the villages. Thẩm wears all three in the Hall of Cold Law so the inner halls see what the coast pays.

sets.name: Keeper of the Lid (Thủ Cái Song Bảo)
sets.story: Both cut from one locust tree of Hòe Âm, the wood sent by her childhood friend Thái Lê Tuyết when Tiết laid the Array's last nodes. She wears them with the Clear-Heart Mirror, which is the Keeper's, not hers.

sets.name: Red and White Plums (Hồng Bạch Song Mai)
sets.story: Lãnh Hương Các's two plum swords and the cape of its last swordsman, Phó Thanh Mai. The red was lost at Cô Thành in 726. Phó Ám Hương wears the white and his father's cape, and the set is whole only if he takes the red back from Phượng Minh.

sets.name: Ice Heart Regalia (Băng Tâm Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Keeper's Stillness (Chưởng Hồ Chi Tĩnh)

sets.story: Tần held all three. The Mirror went to Tiết Hàn Mai in 820 for the Array's last nodes, and Sở Ngọc Hồ has never asked for it back. The Regalia is whole only in one pair of hands, so succession and Tiết's death decide who holds it.

sets.name: Step for Step (Bộ Bộ Tương Tùy)
sets.story: The robe she was found in and her master's first sword: the two things the Keeper has given anyone along with her surname.

sets.name: Slack Water (Triều Đình Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The crab he killed for her, the abbey's mirror and her village's robe. Lương Bạch Tần holds all three. The set's name is the hour the crab died, and the hour she meets the head on the shoal.

sets.name: The Crossing (Độ Hải Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Somewhere Else by Morning (Hiểu Tại Tha Phương)

sets.story: The fan, the token and the coat of the first ferry, gathered by the man who has crossed every day since 1110. Bùi Phiêu Bình holds all three.

sets.name: The Bird Mother (Điểu Mẫu)
sets.story: The whistle from the bird she took her name from and the fan of her flock's feathers. She wears both. The pavilion says the set is the flock's and she only carries it.

sets.name: Rider of the Green Field (Thanh Điền Kỵ Cụ)

bonuses.effect: Rider and King (Kỵ Vương Đồng Phong)

sets.story: The founder's bell, which the king wears on its leg, and the robe of the marsh's down. Whole only while the king lets her ride: if Thanh Điền chooses another rider, the bell goes with him. She fights with the catalogue's Heron Fan with them.

sets.name: The Unbroken Thread (Bất Đoạn Ti)

bonuses.effect: Fire Runs the Thread (Hỏa Tẩu Ti)

sets.story: The shuttle and the robe it wove. She wears both. The set will be whole for a season at a time, until she weaves silk that lasts.

sets.name: Assayer's Tools (Thí Kim Tam Khí)
sets.story: Crucible, stamp and robe of the house's founder, made in its first decade. They are the house; whoever holds all three is its head, whatever the house's book says.

sets.name: Thumb on the Scale (Thủ Chỉ Áp Cân)
sets.story: The founder's House Weight and the counterweight its keeper cast for it in 1160. Tưởng Ngọc Cân keeps both on the house's side of the square, and never lets them be weighed apart.

sets.name: The Granary (Thương Lẫm Tam Kiện)
sets.story: The bell rung at the first sheaf, the granary seal and the seed gourd: the Lục harvest, which the Tower counts before anyone else's.

sets.name: The Hỗ Fleet (Hỗ Gia Thuyền Đội)

bonuses.effect: Leave With the Tide (Tùy Triều Khứ)

sets.story: His father's ring, his mother's sailcloth and the mirror the house reads the weather in: the marriage that made the white sands a trading town, worn by its son.

sets.name: Locust Shade (Hòe Âm Tam Kiện)
sets.story: The locust seal of the clan, the knot from his father's rope and the dye works' robe: everything the Tiêu kept while they waited eighty years for the cave.

sets.name: Reeling Thread (Trừu Ti Song Kiện)
sets.story: The house's needle and the thimble of its first head: they pass together to the best reeler, never to the eldest child.

sets.name: The Old Hall (Cựu Đường Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Swallow Returns to Its Nest (Yến Hoàn Cựu Sào)

sets.story: The three things the Tạ carried out of their old hall in 470: the fan, the ink jade and the hall's seal. The head holds the fan and the seal, his elder son the jade; the set is whole only in one pair of hands, which by custom means the next head. Tạ Cựu Đường has not given his son the fan, and his son has not asked.

sets.name: Twin Bridges (Song Kiều Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Pillar in the Flood (Lưu Trung Trụ)

sets.story: The toll seal his father cut in 900, the pillar face and the flood coat: the Ôn bridges as one man wears them.

sets.name: Rings of the Armillary (Tuyền Cơ Tam Hoàn)

bonuses.effect: Ring Within the Ring (Hoàn Trung Hoàn)

sets.story: The armillary's spare circle, the ecliptic flag cut from the same bronze in 180, and the keeper's robe. They go to whoever keeps Tuyền Cơ Nghi, not to the prioress as such.

sets.name: Pole Star Court (Bắc Thần Tinh Đình)
sets.story: The lake mirror of 160 and the flag the head made for himself in 560, the year he took the abbey's centre. Whole in his hands for six centuries; the Mountain-Pressing Seal presses what the field has gathered.

sets.name: The Grain Rain (Cốc Vũ Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Rain That Does Not Stop (Vũ Bất Tuyệt)

sets.story: The founder's banner and seed gourd and the abbess's own robe, worn together at every Grain Rain since 1000. She wore them nine days running in the drought of 1150, and her meridians have not been right since.

sets.name: The Blood-Ink Study (Huyết Mặc Văn Phòng)
sets.story: Mặc Huyết Sinh's robe, needle and seal. The brush that wrote with them, Huyết Mặc Bút, is not part of the set: it is the hand, not the study. Triệu Huyết Y wears two pieces. The third is in the hound's keeping at the Pivot's seat, taken from the dead man's belt by the hunter who let her past him in the smoke. She would need the seal to open the door and the brush to finish the canon. The set is whole only if she robs the Pivot's hound.

sets.name: The Pedlar's Pack (Hồn Thương Tam Bảo)
sets.story: His father's cracked bell, the Tower's nine-wick lamp and the robe with the ledger in it. He holds all three. Hám says the set is honest because every breath in it is written down, all but one.

sets.name: Keeper of U Lan (U Lan Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: A Breath That Costs No One (Bất Tổn Tức)

sets.story: The orchid stone, the lamp at the gorge mouth and the robe from the hall that sent her away. All three are hers. She made the set to need no one's breath, and it holds for a fight. It does not hold for a night.

sets.name: Night-Glow Raider (Dạ Quang Tặc)

bonuses.effect: Cut the Horse First (Tiên Trảm Mã)

sets.story: The sabre and the cup from the first raid in 970, and the tally of the silver that started it. Hạng wears the three and carries the Blood Kindling ring besides; the set is the raid, and the knee he bent in 1121 is not in it.

sets.name: Red Band (Xích Đội)
sets.story: Everything here she took: a rider's sabre, his mail under her felt, a ring won at dice. Đồ wears them as the band's colours, and the band is hers, not her husband's.

sets.name: The Sealed Room (Phong Thất Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: A Room Full of Fume (Mãn Thất Yên)

sets.story: What the founder kept when he gave the Hall away: his gourd, his robe, and the censer lit the day he went blind. He has not let the Mistress take any of it out of the room.

sets.name: Canopy and Lid (Hoa Cái Song Bảo)
sets.story: The founder's furnace and the fan the Mistress took up the year he went blind. She says the two were always meant to be used together; he says he never had a fan.

sets.name: The Back Garden (Hậu Viên Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The gourd over Hàn Tư Quân's grave, the trellis pins and the ring of her father's tree. She made the set herself in the garden, and none of it has ever been through the front door.

sets.name: Tea at the Manor (Trang Trà Song Bảo)
sets.story: The robe and the pot are the mistress's own, made for the gracious door. She wears them beside Phi Hồng, which is half of another pair, Lạc Anh's twin swords. That pair waits on Tàn Hồng and is not part of this set.

sets.name: First Light (Sơ Hiểu Tam Kiện)
sets.story: The axe he has felled with since 910, the Grandmother Fir's heartwood and his father's white wax: the warden's whole life, worn in the forest he keeps.

sets.name: Water Over Fire (Thủy Hỏa Ký Tế)
sets.story: The censer holds the fire and the gourd holds the water, and the canon says an alchemist needs both; the founder's coal ring is the hand that tends them. Đồng carries the ember and the ring, Tần carries the gourd. The valley says the next head will be whoever wears all three. Đồng has not offered the ember, and Tần has not asked for it.

sets.name: Snow Hearth (Tuyết Lô Song Bảo)
sets.story: The Snow Hearth Primer in two things: the jacket and the censer she made for the Water half of her root. She wears them beside the Snow-Melt Gourd of Water Over Fire.

sets.name: Moon over Pearl (Nguyệt Châu Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The pearl of 470, the mistresses' robe and the grandmother's pin. Kiều Nguyệt Châu holds all three; the Moon-Well Pendant stays in her keeping, unworn. She means the pin for her grand-niece, which would split the set.

sets.name: The Lone Crane's Things (Cô Hạc Tam Vật)
sets.story: The sword and the bone came to him together from his master at dawn in 900; the robe is his own. No one made them a set: he found that with the bone on his chest the sword half-wakes, and he has never taken it off.

sets.name: The Still Pool (Đàm Ảnh Tam Vật)
sets.story: His master's robe, the mirror that took the bolt, and the bell he sank in the pool after he went blind. Gathered by grief, not made; whole while he sits by the water.

sets.name: What the Old Man Kept (Quy Khư Di Vật)
sets.story: Not made together: a vase from the year 0 and a bead from 400, kept by one man, which have learned to work as one because nothing else has stayed with him that long. Hermits make no regalia; this is what a life leaves. He wears the Primordial Mirror beside them.

sets.name: Candle and Ink (Chúc Mặc Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Seven Stars in One Stroke (Nhất Bút Thất Tinh)

sets.story: The founder's candle and the ink gourd Kỷ Ngân Chúc made when she took the hall in 1137. The candle stays in the hall; she carries it out only to fight, and the hall does not like it. She wears them beside the Talisman-Bearer's Ring.

sets.name: The Nine Landings (Cửu Độ Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Round the Bend, Then the Anchor (Hồi Khúc Trầm Mao)

sets.story: The founder's seal and anchor, and his Dao partner's coat. Giang Cửu Khúc holds all three. The Drowned Anchor of the catalogue stays aboard his boat.

sets.name: Heap of Snow (Tuyết Đôi)
sets.story: The straw cape, the old men's gourd and a stone from under the ice: the river's own set, made by no smith. Bồ means them to go to the first disciple who reaches the ninth layer.

sets.name: Lone Line (Cô Tuyến)

bonuses.effect: The Line Is Patient (Tuyến Năng Nhẫn)

sets.story: The bone hook that was the school's first made thing and the robe he wore while he pieced the method back together.

sets.name: Twin Swords of the Armoury (Võ Khố Song Kiếm)

bonuses.effect: Lightning and Frost (Tử Điện Thanh Sương)

sets.story: Forged by Thiệu Song Phong in 360 (C083) and parted at Chiết Kích Nguyên in 803 (C159). Held together, either sword would wake for a head with no Thunder and no Ice. This is why Tô Vãn Chiếu wants Thanh Sương back, and why Cảnh Trường Thiên is afraid she will ask him to fetch it.

sets.name: The Cloud Bridge Works (Vân Kiều Tam Cụ)
sets.story: The flags, the anchor-pin and the lamp of the miners: everything Quách Tiếp Vân took from Vân Kiều to build the bridge. All three are his.

sets.name: Debt and Wall (Trái Bích Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Every Debt Called (Hữu Trái Tất Hoàn)

sets.story: His wife's tally, his father's copper and the old treasury's door: what Trầm Tịch Dương has counted on for five centuries. All three are his. The Mirror of the Second Seat stays in the treasury hall, unworn while he wears the wall.

sets.name: The Envoy's Errand (Sứ Giả Tam Bảo)
sets.story: Her master's fan, her own fare and the vassals' stitches: Hách Ánh Hà's whole errand. All three are hers.

sets.name: The Miasma Watch (Thủ Chướng Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Outlast the Grey (Trì Cửu Hôi Trung)

sets.story: The warden's lantern, anchor and coat, all made in 806 and handed from warden to warden. Hình Trọng Sơn holds all three; whoever keeps the Watch after him inherits the set.

sets.name: Nails of Đào Sa (Đào Sa Đinh)
sets.story: What the river gave back after 1173: the nails and the coat on the peg. Both are Lữ Tẫn Chu's.

sets.name: What Came Off the Field (Chiết Kích Di Vật)
sets.story: A sword from the dead's halberds, an empty scabbard and his master's coat: the three things Cảnh Trường Thiên carried off Chiết Kích Nguyên. He holds all three. The share-the-damage half is the closest line until targets-tl/geese-line exists.

sets.name: Pear-Blossom Vigil (Lê Hoa Thủ Tịch)

bonuses.effect: Until It Stops Wanting (Chí Bất Dục Chiến)

sets.story: The abbess's three for the sit against the seal: the bell cast from the frozen tribulation's ice, the robe, and the Moonrime sword (the catalogue's ice-moonrime-sword, which carries no set field of its own). Thái wears all three; in 1202 she means to walk to the cave in them with the nun she chooses.

sets.name: Prize and Brush (Ấn Bút Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Glow After Dark (Hà Quang Bất Tán)

sets.story: The brush the head gave her at birth and the prize it won at fourteen. Tô Mộ Vân holds both but, at Luyện Khí, can wear only one: she wears the seal, and the set waits for her foundation.

sets.name: Sunset Regalia (Lạc Hà Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Sky Goes One Colour (Nhất Sắc Thiên)

sets.story: The founder held all three. In 1179 Tô Vãn Chiếu pledged the Lone Duck Ring to Phan Vật Hoa for the loan that built the Cloud Bridge. The Regalia will be whole again when the loan is paid. The sect believes the ring is in the treasury vault.

sets.name: The Gate (Sơn Môn Tam Kiện)
sets.story: The prioress's grey sword, the coat she was found in and the beads of the sisters who raised her: everything she owns, worn at the gate she has never left.

sets.name: Three Hundred Paces (Tam Bách Bộ)
sets.story: The veil she walked in with and the sword her father gave her when she walked out, both steeped by Tào Mộ Tử's hand. Hình Lạc Nhạn holds both.

sets.name: Bobtail Chief's Gear (Đoản Vĩ Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Never Had a Healer (Vô Y Giả)

sets.story: One lynx made the axe and the armour; the ring came with the band. Whole since 1150; Triều Ngũ Lang knows where Khấu would leave them.

sets.name: The Digger's Kit (Quật Phu Tam Cụ)
sets.story: Lamp, seal and coat of the boss of the ruin-diggers, gathered over eighty years of dead halls. She means to leave them to whoever outlives her on the coast.

sets.name: Thaw-Girl's Fire (Giải Băng Song Hỏa)
sets.story: The brazier Phàn Cổ Đăng bought her in 1195 and the coal the lamp-boss sealed from it a year later. A Luyện Khí wears one thing, so the pendant waits on a cord in her pack until her Trúc Cơ.

sets.name: Woodcutter's Pair (Tiều Phu Song Bảo)
sets.story: His father's axe and his mother's vest. Tuần Tùng Đường offered him a sword for the axe; he has not answered.

sets.name: The Free Crossing (Nghĩa Độ Song Vật)
sets.story: His stern lamp, lit since 1174, and the crossing's stone anchor, older than any ferryman there. They will pass with the boat.

sets.name: Hắc Phong Twin Hooks (Hắc Phong Song Câu)
sets.story: The chief of Hắc Phong carried both. Since 940 one has been in the south with the daughter who got away and one in the Pivot's service with the son who was taken. The pair is whole only if the two meet, and one of them gives up a blade.

sets.name: Miasma Walker (Chướng Hành Tam Vật)

bonuses.effect: Walked Out of Chiết Kích (Xuất Chiết Kích)

sets.story: A goat's bell he came out of the miasma with, and the clay-soaked robe and cellar door he has carried back in since. Quý Thủ Lũy has asked twice what he would leave them to.

sets.name: Night Rain Stall (Dạ Vũ Song Vật)

bonuses.effect: Leave While It Burns (Phần Thời Tẩu)

sets.story: The false seal he carved the winter he was turned out of Nam Phố, and the robe of wrong maps he lined at Thu Trì.

sets.name: Stockade Mistress (Thạch Môn Song Bảo)
sets.story: What she took from the ridge besides the Black Wind Hook: her mail and the lightning sand. She wears them beside the hook, whose twin is with her brother.

sets.name: The Hundred Jars (Bách Úng Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The cellar's seal, the cask and the apron. The wine-master holds all three. They are worth more to Kim Vạn Lý than to the school, and he knows it.

sets.name: The Sweet Spring (Cam Tuyền Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The founder's needles, the gourd of the true spring and the robe of the red dawn. The head holds all three. It is the healers' set, not the cellars', and she means the school to remember the difference.

sets.name: Apricot Clinic (Hạnh Hoa Y Cụ)

bonuses.effect: Apricot Clinic's Spring (Hạnh Quán Hồi Xuân)

sets.story: Her old master Mẫn Tế Thế's needles, and the gourd and jade she added to them. Her heir Nhiêu Tử Uyển uses the needles when she is away, and gives them back.

sets.name: The Bào Hull (Bào Gia Thuyền Cụ)

bonuses.effect: Ride Out the Storm (Đạp Phong Ba)

sets.story: Anchor, armour and bell of the Bào ship-house, made from its first hull and its breakwater. They pass to the master of the house; his daughter would take them to sea with Diêm Hải Tảo.

sets.name: The Carried Array (Huề Trận Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Array Comes With Me (Trận Tùy Thân)

sets.story: Seal, flag and shield of a runaway formation master: the seal he cut the year he left the abbey, the flag he copied from its pattern, the shield he bought with his first fee. Củng Tinh wants the flag back more than it wants him.

sets.name: Collected in Full (Thu Túc Song Bảo)
sets.story: Her own pair: a coin from her first collection and the jade she bought back. The Golden Valley seal she holds as surety stays in its box: it is a pledge, not hers to wear.

sets.name: Fair Weights (Công Xứng Song Bảo)
sets.story: The Từ house's ring and robe of office, which pass to its head. She wears them beside the Golden Valley coin, whose suite is not hers to complete.

sets.name: Golden Valley Suite (Kim Cốc Tam Bảo)
sets.story: Kim Cốc Viên's three treasures, split by its fall: the coin sold to the Từ house in 1004, the seal kept by the Quản as surety, the pearl lost in the ash. Quản Phục Thu wants all three, and Từ Bỉnh Quyền will not sell.

sets.name: The Losing Hand (Thua Thủ Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Lose to Win (Dĩ Thua Vi Thắng)

sets.story: Ring and robe of a man who bets badly on purpose, made for himself three centuries apart; he throws the Heaven-Minted Coin from inside them.

sets.name: Vermilion and Azure (Đan Thanh Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Even Failures Are Pills (Bại Diệc Đan)

sets.story: The two colours of his father's trade and the censer he made his name with. He calls it a joke; it is the only thing he owns that he will not sell.

sets.name: Bridge Bells (Kiều Linh Song Bảo)
sets.story: The hand bell and the jade from home. Thẩm Hưởng Nhi holds both; since 1191 both have answered on nights with no wind.

sets.name: Pendant and Bell (Bội Ngọc Minh Loan)
sets.story: Cast and carved together for the founders' Dao-partner rite in 960, when the bell rang against the jade. In Vương Bột's line the jade pendants and the luan bells fall silent when the feast is over. Yến Bội Ngọc wears both, and the set is whole. The rite robe she wore that day is the third piece; she had it rewoven with a thread of the Winter Crack in 1121, and wears all three.

sets.name: Horse Lord of the Plain (Mã Chủ Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: One Thread of Wind (Nhất Tuyến Phong)

sets.story: The founder's lance, the foal's bridle ring and the armour of thirty-one races. Khấu Mục Vân holds all three; the Packmate Collar is Đạp Vân's to wear, not his, and the set's last line does its work.

sets.name: The Last of Phù Dao (Phù Dao Di Vật)
sets.story: The abbey's pennant and habit, and her father's stone. Thôi Dương Giác holds all three, and means to hand the first two to whoever lights the abbey after her.

sets.name: Plum and Snow (Mai Tuyết Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Bare Branch Blooms (Khô Chi Khai Hoa)

sets.story: His sworn brother's sword and his village's cloak. Lăng Đạp Tuyết holds both.

sets.name: The Dawn Half (Triêu Phi Bán Bích)
sets.story: The founder's seal and brush and a robe from home. Châu Phi Vân holds all three; the set pays for paper the way the Talisman-Bearer's Ring did, and the ring stays in her keeping, unworn. The founders' art had two halves; so does the hall's treasure, and the dusk half is Kha's.

sets.name: The Dusk Half (Mộ Quyển Bán Bích)

bonuses.effect: Roll Up the Western Rain (Quyển Tây Sơn Vũ)

sets.story: Ôn Châu Liêm's banner and seal, and the robe of a failed scholar. Kha Triêu Phi holds all three. The hall says the whole Painted Beams talisman needs both halves in one room.

sets.name: Out of the Grey (Xuất Hôi Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Last Man in the File (Mạt Hàng Nhân)

sets.story: The banner, the cloth and the shield of the file of forty. Mục Hàn Nhạn holds all three. The shared-damage half is the closest line until targets-tl/geese-line exists.

sets.name: Point of the File (Hàng Đầu Song Bảo)
sets.story: The sword and the coat of the point, handed to each holder in turn. Mục Tân Vũ is the tenth to hold both.

sets.name: The Idle Cloud (Nhàn Vân Tam Bảo)
sets.story: Her own silk, her master's brush and her own robe. Diệp Tố Quyên holds all three. The founder's half sky is not a piece, and she will not let anyone make it one.

sets.name: Mother's Sky (Mẫu Thiên Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Figure on the Clouds (Vân Thượng Nhân)

sets.story: Her mother's last scroll and her mother's brush. Tần Đảo Ảnh holds both.

sets.name: The Ash Seat (Tro Tọa Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The fan from the siege of 724, the censer lit in 952 and the robe that has lain in the vent's ash since. The grand elder has held all three for two hundred years, and the palace's breakthroughs happen beside them.

sets.name: The Morning the Birds Fell Silent (Điểu Tịch Chi Triêu)

bonuses.effect: Light on the Pipe (Quản Thượng Quang)

sets.story: Her brother's flute and the head's robe: what she was left, and what she was given. She wears both. Only Light can open the set, and she is the only Light in the palace.

sets.name: Five-Virtue Regalia (Ngũ Đức Nghi)

bonuses.effect: The Phoenix Comes with Stately Grace (Phượng Hoàng Lai Nghi)

sets.story: The founder made the robe in 505 and the seal in 485, and in 1100 the fan to go with them. The fan and robe went to the Fire Court with the head in 1162 (N-phuong_minh-12); the seal stayed on the ridge with Vu Ngô Đồng, because the founder said it stays with the tree. The Regalia is whole only if the head takes the seal from the Wutong Court, which the ridge would call a theft, or goes back up the ridge to wear it.

sets.name: The Hall Stands (Nghĩa Đường Song Bảo)
sets.story: What Sử Hoành Dực carries in place of the fan that was taken: the mail he had made after the pass and her pendant. He wears them beside the left wing, and the Twin Wings stay parted until the Tower gives the right one back.

sets.name: The Nest Array (Sào Trận Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Fire Down the Thread (Hỏa Hành Ti)

sets.story: The Tang family's keeping since 592: the robe, the banner hemmed with the founder's strand, and the seal Tang Kế Ti cut herself. The set passes with the Nest Array, not with the family, though it has never yet left the family.

sets.name: The Seven Movements (Thất Chương)

bonuses.effect: Never the Eighth (Bất Tấu Đệ Bát)

sets.story: The zither of 760, the drum it was played with and the robe that holds the score. Liên Thiều Nghi holds all three at the Wutong Court. The eighth string has never been restrung, and the set's rule is that it never will be.

sets.name: The Small Morning (Tiểu Triêu Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The head gave all three to her chief disciple, a smaller copy of her own Five-Virtue Regalia. The palace reads it as a promise of succession, and so does he.

sets.name: Twin Wings (Song Dực Phiến)
sets.story: Made for Sử Hoành Dực and Dụ Đan Huỳnh in 1100; parted at Đan Sơn Mạch in 1154.

sets.name: The Wutong Court (Ngô Đồng Đình)
sets.story: The first elder made both for the ridge after the court left it in 1162. They are the Wutong Court's, not the palace's, and he fights in them with the Ashen Phoenix fan. The Seal of the Wutong belongs to the Five-Virtue Regalia; it stays on the tree's altar at the Court, not on his belt.

sets.name: Yellow Chrysanthemums (Hoàng Cúc)
sets.story: His mother painted the fan and stitched the jerkin, both for the day he went up to the palace. He wears both to every duel.

sets.name: Master of the Sittings (Tọa Sư Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The ring from the day he became an elder, the mail of the sitting stones and the board shield from the Fire Court's steps. He holds all three, and the hall reads the board as a sign of where his friends are.

sets.name: Standing in the Fire (Lập Hỏa Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Burn and Get Back Up (Phần Nhi Khởi)

sets.story: Two pieces are his own, from the day in 1020 he stood in the vent. The third is the Xích Hà Kỳ, which is not his: Phượng Minh lent it out of the Hall of Spoils, and Xích Thành wove it. The set is whole only while the palace's loan stands.

sets.name: Grey Sleeve and Seal (Phất Y Khế Ấn)
sets.story: The founder's robe and a sleeve of the dead. The robe passes head to head; the sleeve is chosen from the beams by each new head, and no head says whose. He fights with the Thousand-Cut Sword beside them.

sets.name: Hired Sword's Pair (Dung Kiếm Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Hired Sword's Full Pay (Dung Kiếm Thanh Toán)

sets.story: The contract keeper's seal and sword: one signs the hire, the other keeps it. They pass with the post.

sets.name: Lamp and Brush (Đăng Bút Song Bảo)
sets.story: The first lantern and the brush that wrote it, both from the shop at Hồ Khẩu Thôn. Văn Hàn Đăng holds both.

sets.name: Old Ivory Hunt (Lão Nha Liệp)

bonuses.effect: Drag It to the Ice (Duệ Thượng Băng)

sets.story: The founder's harpoon, the coat cut from the strip of hide the Old Ivory left on it, and his sworn brother's ring. Đoàn wears all three on every hunt; he says he will take them off when the whale is dead.

sets.name: Hammer, Pearl and Coin (Chùy Châu Tiền)

bonuses.effect: Going Once, Going Twice (Nhất Phách Nhị Phách)

sets.story: The auction's seal, the pearl grown in her and the coin that buys fate. Phan Vật Hoa holds all three. The coin is a catalogue piece (general-heaven-purchasing-coin) with no set field of its own; this set names it as the third piece, and her master's Mirror of the Third Price stays in her keeping, unworn. A set that cannot be sold is the studio's only joke.

sets.name: The Xích Kim Furnace (Xích Kim Lô Cụ)

bonuses.effect: Fights With What He Made (Dĩ Sở Tạo Chiến)

sets.story: Three generations' apron, the lid he cracked and the sword he would not sell. Khang Thiên Chùy holds all three, and they are the one set in Thiên Bảo Trai that has never been in the auction book.

sets.name: The Herb Terraces (Dược Điền Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Rain on the Sown Field (Vũ Lạc Bá Điền)

sets.story: The founder's gourd, her master's fan and the valley's bell. Nghiêm Linh Chi holds all three; they go to the next valley-mistress together, or the terraces say the year's harvest fails.

sets.name: The Governor's Charge (Thủ Tân Song Bảo)
sets.story: The seal and the lantern of the Cold Ford governor, made in 672. Nhiếp Cô Tân has the seal; the lantern was left on the quay at Hàn Tân in 905. He would give a great deal for it, and more for the war that would let him walk onto that quay and look. The governor's coat, made with them, came off Giáp Tùng Chi's body in Nhiếp's hands that day, so he wears two of the three; the Charge is whole only with the lantern from under the quay stones.

sets.name: Cut Bridges (Đoạn Kiều Song Bảo)
sets.story: Her father's blade and the rope of the bridge he died on, which came home together in 1174. Nhiếp Vãn Đào holds both.

sets.name: The Ferryman's Remedy (Độ Gia Song Bảo)
sets.story: A gourd from the ferry and needles wound in its rope: Bồ Hạnh Lâm made the second piece in 1185 to match the first. Both are Đàm Thanh Giang's, and the set is whole.

sets.name: Swan Goose and Swimming Dragon (Kinh Hồng Du Long)
sets.story: Not made together: the founder's sash of 200, the wolf king's tooth of 455 and the pin she cut in 900. She bound them with one cord the morning she retired, and they have answered one another since. All three are hers; the Thousand Roots Banner stays furled at Thính Đào Nhãn.

sets.name: The Ice-Breaker's Array (Phá Băng Trận Cụ)
sets.story: The nine flags of 904, a seal for the ward-songs and his father's keel. Cận Tùng Hàn holds all three, and the flags are still rolled; the set has not been worn whole since that winter.

sets.name: Pine Waves Regalia (Tùng Đào Tam Bảo)
sets.story: Kỳ Tùng Ẩn made all three in the palace's first thirty years. Unlike the regalia of Băng Tâm and Thúy Vi, Tùng Đào's has never been split: Thôi Khinh Hồng handed all three to Đàm Tùng Lại in one morning in 900. The Coiled Root Hall says a head who gave up the Cold Ford should not wear them, and Đàm, who agrees more than he says, wears only the robe except at the new year.

sets.name: Rain over the Long Lake (Trường Hồ Vũ)
sets.story: The teaching fan, the pearl from home and the robe of the Hall of Voices, gathered over three centuries. All are Hồ Tùng Nguyệt's, and the hall expects them to pass to whoever keeps it after her.

sets.name: Relics of Still Water (Tĩnh Thủy Tam Di)
sets.story: The abbey's lamp, her mother's habit and the River Hall's ring: two relics of the flood of 700 and the hand of the man who sent it. Dụ Tĩnh Lưu wears all three, and only she knows why that is a penance.

sets.name: The Unwritten Score (Vô Tự Cầm Phổ)
sets.story: A zither from Vạn Hác's head, a pendant from Vạn Hác's head and a robe from her own master. Vi Thanh Âm holds all three. The set's name is the palace's joke for the canon that is never written down; she does not laugh at it.

sets.name: Fallen Star Forge (Tinh Lạc Lô Cụ)
sets.story: Made in his first years as head: the star sword of 1050, the brand that marked it, and the robe the quench-keeper sewed for him in 1060. Whole since then.

sets.name: The Map Wall (Đồ Bích)
sets.story: The hunter's sword with its 412 notches and the coat that carries the map wall's caves: what the Tiêu son took with him when the hermitage turned him away.

sets.name: The Autumn Graves (Thu Phần Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The bell Ân Thanh Linh cast in 1062, the seal of the first grave jade, and the robe of the barred door. The head holds all three. The Pavilion says the set is not hers but the graves', lent to whoever hears them.

sets.name: The Second Copy (Phó Bản)
sets.story: The drum and the robe that hides the second copy. The head does not know they make a set, because she does not know what is in the lining.

sets.name: Father's Road (Phụ Lộ)

bonuses.effect: The Rider Comes In (Kỵ Tự Lai)

sets.story: Both made from what was left on the road below Viên Đề Hạp in 1100: her father's sabre and his wagon. She wears them on every caravan.

sets.name: Three Nights on the Road (Tam Dạ Đạo Thượng)
sets.story: The bow and the coat of the wolf winter. Hứa Vãn Cung holds both.

sets.name: The Rain Record (Vũ Ký Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Flood Feeds the Garden (Thủy Dưỡng Điền)

sets.story: The gauge, the terrace fan and the coast oilskin, all of the Water Fields. She holds all three and carries them to Tử Trúc Lâm and back, which the head has not noticed.

sets.name: The Yearly Seed (Niên Chủng Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The censer, the bell that stopped ringing and the ring of the seed-picker who bore him. The head holds all three and wears them into the grove every spring. The bell is silent because he has not let the grove flower, and he hopes no one asks why.

sets.name: Cliff Hall Champion (Nhai Đường Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Lean Until It Breaks (Ỷ Chí Đoạn)

sets.story: The ridge's champion's set: the cypress banner, his father's jade block and the Cliff Hall coat Cù gave him. He wears it at the new seat to remind them where it came from.

sets.name: Pine on the Cliff (Nhai Tùng)

bonuses.effect: The Pine That Does Not Move (Bất Động Tùng)

sets.story: Bark from the founder's pine and an axe from her father's workshop: the ridge's two crafts, wood and jade. Cù wears them beside the founder's Seed Gourd, which belongs to the Regalia and not to her.

sets.name: Cold Ford Watch (Hàn Tân Canh)

bonuses.effect: No Hiding on the Quay (Ngạn Vô Ẩn)

sets.story: The lamp found unbroken in 905, a spear from the quay's own iron and the warden's winter coat. The Cold Ford Hall's warden has worn the three since 940 and means his daughter to wear them after him.

sets.name: Evening Ferry (Vãn Độ)

bonuses.effect: Reach and Root (Cập Viễn Trát Căn)

sets.story: The quay's pole and the marsh's reeds: the coast girl who chose to grow rice where her father wanted war.

sets.name: Far Ambition (Viễn Chí)

bonuses.effect: Everything at Once (Nhất Thời Tề Phát)

sets.story: The cloth he was left in and the needle he made too fast: who he was and who he is in a hurry to be.

sets.name: Field and Garden (Điền Viên Tam Kiện)
sets.story: The first elder's seal and jacket and his Dao partner's gourd. Each refuses to keep the other's piece. Each spring at the planting, whoever finished sowing first is handed the other's: in his years the set is whole for one season; in hers she wears the seal beside her gourd.

sets.name: Green Fire (Thanh Hỏa Tam Kiện)
sets.story: The Furnace Hall's master's three: the green furnace he keeps, the needle he reads pulses with, and the clamp-cloth of his home village. Úy says the set will be whole only when the Purple Smoke Furnace sits beside it.

sets.name: Emerald Haze Regalia (Thúy Vi Tam Bảo)
sets.story: Phùng Yên Hà held all three. The seal and the robe went down to Cổ Dịch Trấn with Ngu Lam Sơn in 1006. The gourd stayed on the ridge with Cù Thúy Bách, who says the founder's seeds belong beside the founder's tree. The Regalia has not been whole for 194 years, and Cù will trade the gourd only for the sect's return, or for the heir she chooses.

sets.name: Poria Under Pine (Tùng Hạ Phục Linh)
sets.story: Her mirror, her village's gourd and her master's robe: a support's set, made for the quiet sect she wants to keep.

sets.name: The Salt Chest (Diêm Rương Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: What the Chest Kept (Rương Trung Vật)

sets.story: Everything the pirates left in the cove with a three-year-old girl: the lock, a fan under the salt and the cloth around it. Diêm has never learned whether the chest was meant for her.

sets.name: Thunder on the Cone (Sơn Hỏa Lôi)
sets.story: One piece from the outer gate and one from the old tower. At Luyện Khí she can wear only the sword; the ring waits in her box for the day she reaches Trúc Cơ, by the inner gate's rule or against it.

sets.name: The Undefeated (Bất Bại Song Kiện)
sets.story: Both come from Kinh Điện: the sword her father forged in 656 and the mail the Tower forged her in 1166 from the same mine. She wears them with the catalogue's Unbroken Edge ring, which keeps her drawn-out cut whole between strikes. Phượng Minh's right wing fan hangs in her room as a trophy and is not part of it.

sets.name: Drum of the Gate (Lôi Môn Cổ Bảo)
sets.story: Stick, drum and sword are all of one peach tree on Tử Tinh, if the Hầu family is right. Hầu Vọng Xuân holds all three. He says the Xuân Lôi Cổ would make it four, and his master hears him say it.

sets.name: Glass Storm (Lưu Ly Phong Lôi)
sets.story: Made around her by the two people who raised her: the forge master's glass sword, Quan's robe and the rod she cut herself. She keeps all three, and the Tower watches what she does with them.

sets.name: Gold Sand and Lightning (Sa Kim Lôi)
sets.story: Both come from Sa Kim Khoáng: her mother's leather and her father's ore. She wears both, and she does not ask how the forge was paid.

sets.name: Ears of the Hall (Hồi Âm Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The bell Ân Thanh Linh cast in 1030, the mirror of the Hall's founder and the robe of the trade. All three belong to the Hall of Echoes, not to the Tower, and pass with the Hall from mother to daughter.

sets.name: Night Rain Regalia (Dạ Vũ Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The founder held all three, and so did Mạnh Dạ Vũ until 1166. When the halls moved to Thần Cổ Phong, the chain stayed on the eaves of the old tower over Tàn Hà Hồ, because nobody would take it down, and Quan Vũ Thanh keeps it there. The Regalia has not been whole since. The head says a chain is not a thing one carries. Mạnh Lưu Ly says a head who cannot take it down is not the founder's heir.

sets.name: Keeper of the Old Tower (Cựu Lâu Thủ)
sets.story: The sword and the half-tally are both from 803, the year of the truce, and Quan has carried them together since the founder died. She wears them beside the founder's rain-chain, which belongs to the Night Rain Regalia, not to her. The pair is whole on her; the Regalia is not.

sets.name: Lamp and Shears of the Vaults (Hồn Khố Song Bảo)
sets.story: By the vault law of 1010, a life lamp can be put out from afar only by the master lamp and the shears together, in two hands. Lệ Tiêu Hồn holds the lamp and gave the shears to his niece Ninh Tịch Đăng, so that he could never do it alone. She has refused him once.

sets.name: Hearing the Spring Rain (Thính Xuân Vũ)
sets.story: The head gave him both in 1186, the year he took him, the first gift he had made a disciple in a century. The Tower reads more into it than the boy does.

sets.name: Keeper of Kinh Lôi Mạch (Kinh Lôi Mạch Thủ)
sets.story: Cast together in 1170, when Lệ moved the vaults into the vein. The master lamp is not part of it: by the vault law of 1010 the lamp is half of a pair kept in two hands, and it stays burning in the vaults while he goes out with the brand, the bell and the Ninth Tribulation seal. He made this pair so as to have something whole of his own.

sets.name: Keeper's Desk (Tàng Ước Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Door Stays Shut (Môn Bất Khai)

sets.story: The founder's key, the Compact's inkstone and the keeper's own robe. The key and stone pass with the archive; the robe is hers, and the Pivot will have to make another.

sets.name: Army-Breaker's Harness (Phá Quân Tam Kiện)
sets.story: Spear, coat and stone are what Đỗ Tinh Hà brought back from Phá Quân Môn in 874: the rebel's weapon, the rebel's armour, and the pebble he held while he waited at the gate. They have never been apart; the set dies with him or passes whole.

sets.name: Bridge Court Pair (Kiều Đình Song Bảo)
sets.story: The court's own robe and jade, which go with the bench and not the person. She wears them beside the Weight, so the judge stands whole even when the Regalia is not.

sets.name: Copyist's Pair (Sao Lục Song Bảo)
sets.story: The archive's issue to its copyists, returned when they leave the second door. The ink of a copy no one should have made is still in the left sleeve of Thích Minh Thư's.

sets.name: Drum, Flag and Spear (Cổ Kỳ Thương)
sets.story: The Dao Quang Hall's war kit, made piece by piece for its masters over four centuries. Ngũ Trấn Bắc holds all three, and wants the Armoured Horse to go with them.

sets.name: Dawn Pair (Hi Hòa Song Bảo)
sets.story: Doãn Ngọc Hành had Chân Kim Các refine the sword for her Trúc Cơ in 1168 and gave her the flag twelve years later, so that she would carry the ward as well as the edge.

sets.name: Envoy's Credentials (Sứ Tiết Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Words Before Needles (Tiên Ngôn Hậu Châm)

sets.story: Tally, robe and fan are issued to the master of the Khai Dương Hall and handed back when he leaves the post. Mâu Tri Viễn has held them since 1150.

sets.name: The Armoured Horse (Thiết Mã Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Army That Waits (Phục Binh Tại Cảnh)

sets.story: Made in 785 for the war marshal (C154), parted at Chiết Kích in 803: the banner went into hiding with Lôi Vô Danh, the tally's halves into the realm and out of the archive. Đỗ Tinh Hà has looked for both for four hundred years. Ngũ Trấn Bắc wants them found; Doãn Ngọc Hành would prefer they were not.

sets.name: Regalia of the Pivot (Thiên Xu Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Seal and Weight in One Hand (Ấn Quyền Đồng Thủ)

sets.story: The founder's rule since 510: the one who seals does not weigh. The head holds the Seal and the Flag; the Chief Judge holds the Weight. The set has been whole twice: in Chung Hoài Cực's hands before he gave the Weight away, and for one day in 1188, when Doãn Ngọc Hành asked Phương Trực Ngôn for the Weight and judged Băng Tâm's petition himself (N-thien_xu-09). He returned it the next morning. She has not forgiven it.

sets.name: Plumb and Level (Chuẩn Thằng Quy Củ)
sets.story: His master's tools of the seat: the sword that sets a line, the level that sets a floor, and the plate the steward wears. Given one at a time as he earned them; the elders read the third as a promise.

sets.name: Road Mist (Lộ Vụ)
sets.story: The lantern found burning on the road in 1146 and the flag he painted that night: the cape roads' mist in two things a carrier can hold.

sets.name: The Monk's Things (Không Hạc Di Vật)

bonuses.effect: Silence After the Twelfth (Thập Nhị Hậu Tịch)

sets.story: Everything the monk left in the ravine in 620: the zither, the beads and the robe. Hà Thính Tùng holds all three, and the academy rule is that only a player of the twelfth movement may.

sets.name: The Empty Mountain (Không Sơn Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Sit as Thôi Sat (Như Thôi Tọa)

sets.story: His master's censer, the robe he walked out of Thúy Vi in and the seal he cut that year: the empty mountain's teaching and its last student. Tống wears them and keeps the Heart-Lamp lit on the altar instead.

sets.name: The Reader's Pair (Độc Giả Song Kiện)
sets.story: The academy's door bell and a robe from her own mine: what the abbey gave the one who reads the Sutra aloud.

sets.name: Bells on the Roads (Đạo Linh Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The Clear Bell of 1128, the map of every line and the apron she cast them all in. The mistress holds all three. The line of bells inside Thu Trì's walls that no one knows of is on the banner too, and the set is how she hears it.

sets.name: The Breakwater (Phá Lãng Tam Bảo)
sets.story: The basalt seal, the shield she made for a wall no one built and the shard of the wall that cracked. All three are hers, and none of them is the hall's. That is the argument she has with Ôn Thủ Đăng.

sets.name: The Lamp Chain (Đăng Liên Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Not One Lamp Out (Bất Nhất Đăng Diệt)

sets.story: The lamp he lit the night Kim Sa drowned, the drowned tower's seal the divers brought up in 920, and a diver's robe like the one his sworn brother wore. The hall believes the set was the founder's. Only the seal was, and all three are about one night.

sets.name: Calming the Wind and Waves (Định Phong Ba)
sets.story: The founder's staff and cape, named for the song the guides sing on the road: bamboo staff and straw sandals, lighter than a horse; who is afraid? One straw cape in the misty rain, and let it be all my life. Nhậm Bình Sinh split them in 1169, the staff to the head and the cape to the Road Mother. The Gate reads the split as a division. Phí Thoa Y reads it as a balance. The set is whole only in one pair of hands.

sets.name: The Lamp and the Road (Đăng Lộ Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: The Lamp Does Not Go Out (Đăng Bất Diệt)

sets.story: Her lamp and her beads, the Road Mother's own. She wears them beside the founder's straw cape, which is half of Calming the Wind and Waves. The guides say a Road Mother needs only these two. The founder's pair is a head's business.

sets.name: Son of Thủ Lôi Bảo (Lôi Bảo Song Bảo)
sets.story: His father's jacket and his brother's token: the fort that burned and the pass that was lost. He wears them beside the founder's staff, which is half of Calming the Wind and Waves and whole only when the cape comes back to it.

sets.name: The Dusk Field (Mộ Điền Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Haze Held All Night (Yên Ngưng Chung Dạ)

sets.story: The furnace he will not light, the seed she gave him and the robe of her grave. Diêm Tử Tô holds all three.

sets.name: Evening Glow (Mộ Quang Song Bảo)
sets.story: The founder's furnace and gourd, the one carried lit across the steppe, the other stoppered with his swaddling cloth. Tào Mộ Tử holds both.
